policy.primary: Curated species identity inside its existing family, actual written Species Song mode/pitch class, original-demo-inspired simple but varied phrases.
policy.strict_timbre_alternative: Use the verified production Song topline preset once rendered; table records legacy-equivalent option and flags five differences. This loses most pluck variety.
policy.mega: Use the written Species Song mega lead parity (effective source species + Song arrangement name id, zero for the fixed Species Song); no full mega doubled arrangement in the check.
policy.special_names: Keep curated species preset/phrase identity. If named Check should warm up named track, resolve named key/scale from existing generation helper; name does not shuffle preset. Unnamed fixed Species Song uses resolved swap source. Exact named behavior remains a product choice.
policy.drift: As-written reference is stable. A fixed check cannot match every drifted monthly key. Do not add time/RPC inputs to chase drift without a separate request.

sections.action: head_degrees on selected rhythm; normal gate 5/6 of each slot, velocity96
archetype held degrees, 1920 ticks each; gate1800, velocity100; plucks naturally decay
response_degrees on selected rhythm; gate5/6, velocity96; only motif-response archetypes quote first4 degrees of the production recipe theme

short articulation response: row final_articulation_notes minus4 head-prefix notes then4 cadence notes, eighth slots with40-tick gates,velocity100; pad row final_rest_ticks to keep8bar loop; end on tonic; no drum-kit tail

phrase_recipe.pan: Center by default; ten optional gentle call/response species use CC10=48 for head and80 for response, reset64 before final cadence. This is an aesthetic suggestion, can all stay centered; unlike hard-panned reference406 it remains audible in mono.
